name: FastWisper
author: s3xz
description: Bar status for FastWisper, local offline voice dictation for Omarchy: shows idle, recording, transcribing and error states. Click toggles hands-free dictation, right-click opens the FastWisper hub. Requires the FastWisper app.

schema.label: FastWisper CLI path
schema.description: Absolute path to the fastwisper command. Leave empty to use fastwisper from PATH, then ~/.local/bin/fastwisper.
